candidate.claim: Unmatched ')' pushes escaped output but still decrements state.parens, driving the counter to -1 and corrupting later paren tracking.

evidence.snippet:
push({ type: 'paren', value, output: state.parens ? ')' : '\\)' });
      decrement('parens');

candidate.title: Unbalanced closing paren decrements counter below zero

verifier.reason: At parse.js:805 the code pushes escaped '\)' when state.parens is falsy, yet parse.js:806 unconditionally calls decrement('parens') outside the opt-in strictBrackets guard at parse.js:795, so an unmatched ')' drives the counter below zero and affects later paren truthiness checks at parse.js:805.

candidate.claim: Last-token update uses truthiness of prevIndex, so when the only slash is at index 0 the condition is false and token value/depth/maxDepth are never updated.
candidate.title: Falsy zero index skips last token update

verifier.reason: The code at scan.js:390 gates the final token assignment on truthy prevIndex, while scan.js:382 sets prevIndex to the slash index i, so a sole slash at index 0 leaves prevIndex falsy and skips scan.js:391-393; the trailing token pushed at scan.js:357-359 is not processed by the slash loop at scan.js:366, and scan.js:386 shows the correct prevIndex !== undefined check was available.

candidate.claim: With noext:true scan clears isGlob for all patterns, so plain globs like '*' are incorrectly reported as non-globs.
candidate.title: noext option incorrectly clears isGlob

verifier.reason: The unconditional block at scan.js:301-304 sets isGlob=false whenever opts.noext is true, and the returned state at scan.js:340-353 reports that cleared value after patterns such as brackets set isGlob at scan.js:242-243, so plain globs are reported as non-globs.
